leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize a React context to manage cart state across components
Construct a custom provider component that supplies cart data and functions
Implement state management logic for adding, removing, and updating cart items
Apply the useContext hook to access cart functionality in child components
Configure context values to include both cart items and manipulation methods
Integrate the cart context provider into the application component hierarchy
Manipulate cart state through context functions from different UI components
